title: Winding-Down Usage in Small Business Electricity Supply Early Termination Fees
content:
A site that is winding down bills less in its last months than over its year. For the early termination fee on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the monthly usage on which the remaining kWh are measured follows the winding-down rule.

**Rule.** The average kWh per energy line posted in the 3 months before the handling date is divided by the 12-month average per line; when that ratio is 0.60 or less, the monthly usage is the 3-month average; when it is above 0.60 and no more than 0.90, the monthly usage is the mean of the 3-month and the 12-month averages; when it is above 0.90, the monthly usage is the 12-month average.

## The two averages

- **12-month average:** the kWh of the agreement's energy lines posted in the 12 months before the handling date, divided by the number of those lines. A line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.
- **3-month average:** the kWh of the agreement's energy lines posted in the 3 months before the handling date, divided by the number of those lines. A line falls in those 3 months when fewer than 3 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date. With no energy line in those 3 months the 3-month average is zero.
- With no energy line in the 12 months the ratio is taken as 1, and the monthly usage is the 12-month average.

## Monthly usage by ratio

| 3-month average divided by 12-month average | Monthly usage |
|---|---|
| 0.60 or less | the 3-month average |
| above 0.60, up to 0.90 | the mean of the 3-month and 12-month averages |
| above 0.90 | the 12-month average |

## Hypothetical site, 12-month average 8500 kWh

| 3-month average | Ratio | Monthly usage |
|---|---|---|
| 4500 kWh | 0.529 | 4500 kWh |
| 5100 kWh | 0.60 | 5100 kWh |
| 6800 kWh | 0.80 | 7650 kWh |
| 7650 kWh | 0.90 | 8075 kWh |
| 8000 kWh | 0.941 | 8500 kWh |
